cn.t: Critics find this modern dating two-hander awkwardly amusing but overly familiar, with Yorke and Zegen's chemistry praised while the script leans heavily on clichés and cringe comedy that doesn't always land.

vr.q: Overall, I really enjoyed Strategic Love Play.
